commitMessage: BROKEN: restored working tree snapshot for investigation
notes: CUDA Qwen outputs token 271 ("Paris") for "What is the capital of France?" — CORRECT. Root cause: CUTLASS RowMajor GEMM kernel dispatched with column-major permuted weight views (strideAt(0)==1). Fix: stride contiguity check in CutlassGemmHelper::gemm() to fall through to cuBLAS. Also removed FP16 autocast in MmulHelper.cu that cast FP32→HALF. Test: TestQwenLayerDiagnostics on CUDA.
